reconciliation.formula: 228 initial passes + 7 superseded original failures = 235 unique passing tests; targeted 7 and demo 2 contain 2 already-passing rechecks, which are not added again.

changes.latestPublication: Context routing supplies controlled fixture bytes to active service-worker requests; latest verified target and late-obsolete rejection remain asserted.
changes.onlinePlayback: Production CSP expectation and actual immutable 5s first-item duration replace development override assumptions; muted video, controls and loop assertions preserved.
changes.periodicManifestSync: Actual visible-first-frame readiness, production 8s polling and immutable fixture item boundaries are observed; withdrawal and LKG assertions preserved.
changes.watchdog: Real controlled checksum-verified H264/AAC playback progresses before a deliberate playbackRate=0 stall, then the production 12s watchdog is observed; healthy video remains distinct from a true stall.
changes.demo: Existing secure session established with real browser cookie chain; unauthenticated denial and bounded byte-range assertions retained.

limitations: The final count reconciles the original broad run and explicit passing reruns; it is not a second full-suite execution.
Physical WebOS/LG and native-device acceptance require their own evidence.
